name: Button
purpose: A control that triggers an action. Four emphasis levels form a hierarchy — primary (highest emphasis, the main action), secondary, tertiary (outlined), and quaternary (lowest emphasis / borderless). Available on-light and on-dark, in a default and a Large size.
when: emphasis in (primary, secondary, tertiary, quaternary) AND label = text — the default of the role; yields to icon-button (roles.json when: "space is tight and the glyph is universal") when label = glyph, to split-button (when: "one main action plus a menu of related ones") when a menu hangs off the action, and to links (when: "the action is navigation inside running text") when the action is navigation in prose.

variants.name: primary
variants.use: Highest-emphasis main action. Solid brand-red fill.

variants.name: tertiary
variants.use: Lower-emphasis action. Outlined (border) on a white fill.

variants.name: quaternary
variants.use: Lowest-emphasis / borderless (ghost) action; shares tertiary background tints on hover/press.

label.$note: secondary inverts to a light fill in dark, so flat-white text/reverse would be white-on-white; text/on-inverse is #FFF light / #333 dark (decision: Dave 2026-06-19)

tokens.$darkDecisions: (Dave, 2026-06-19) (1) Inverting labels: secondary + primary PRESSED use text/on-inverse, not text/reverse (which stays flat white for primary-on-red). (2) Disabled label on solid buttons (primary & secondary) = text/on-inverse — white on the light disabled fill, #333 on the dark disabled fill (intentionally ghosted; disabled is contrast-exempt). (3) tertiary/border/default dark bumped #474747→#767676 so the outlined button's border stays ≥3:1 (was ~1.9:1, near-invisible).
tokens.$motionRule-morph: (Dave 2026-06-19) The loading->success morph (spinner -> drawn tick) is scoped to PROCESSING buttons only — actions that complete in-page WITHOUT a refresh (the processing/success states). Standard actions that navigate or submit-and-reload must NOT morph (the success would flash then be discarded by the reload). Implies two button sets in use: standard vs processing/async.

motion.$status: PROMOTED 2026-06-22 (Dave) — 'Refined scale-physics' chosen over the unrestrained 3D-depress (which used a translate + inset shadow Dave had previously removed, and conflicts with the flat/angular brand). Dimensionality is expressed through SCALE only — no shadow, no translate.
motion.hover: Grows toward the cursor — transform scale(--hs), where --hs = 1 + 7px/buttonWidth (a FIXED ~7px grow regardless of width, set per-button by JS), eased motion/easing/spring over motion/duration/spring (~300ms, slight overshoot). Full-width buttons do NOT grow (a full-bleed grow overflows the edge) — press only.
motion.press: Recedes + darkens to read as depth WITHOUT a shadow — transform scale(--ps), where --ps = 1 - 9px/buttonWidth, plus filter brightness(.85); transition motion/duration/press (~90ms) on motion/easing/out.
motion.reducedMotion: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, the hover/press transforms + brightness are disabled — the static colour states already convey everything. Motion is decoration over an already-correct static state.
motion.$note: Realises brand-refresh principle 7 ('buttons feel pressed / 3D space') in a brand-safe way. The shadowed 3D-depress remains a recorded exploration CEILING in _fitness-test/button-3up-showcase.html (Unrestrained tier), NOT canon. See _PROMOTION-QUEUE.md + _MOTION-THEMES.md (theme 2 Settle / theme 3 Tactile).

responsive.$status: PROMOTED 2026-06-24 (Dave) — closes Dim 11 (reflow), the last gap to prototype-grade 9/9.
responsive.rule: Single buttons are intrinsically fluid (min-width 96px, label-driven). The action bar (the primary+secondary / confirm-cancel pair) is the responsive unit: inline + right-aligned on a wide container (desktop dialog-footer convention — primary last/right); when the container is narrow it stacks.
responsive.breakpoint: container ≤ 420px (container-query on the action bar, not a viewport media query — reflows to its own width; verified to 320px / WCAG 1.4.10 with zero horizontal overflow).
responsive.stacked: Buttons stack vertically and each goes FULL-WIDTH; the PRIMARY is promoted to the top via order:-1 (mobile action priority); hover-grow is disabled when full-width (a full-bleed scale would overflow — the .full rule). Press (recede/darken) is retained.
responsive.$note: Mirrors the Modals dialog-footer behaviour (.actions stack + full-width ≤480px). Built/verified in _fitness-test/button-responsive.html, then folded into the gated reference.

obeys.$why: Rank semantics for primary/secondary/tertiary/quaternary IS this meta's four-level emphasis hierarchy, stated as a rule.
Cardinality — one primary and/or one secondary per page, never both in one group — a composition constraint on this atom.
The buttons-vs-links boundary tells you when this atom is the WRONG answer, which is the `when` gate half of the meta.
The two width modes (set vs dynamic, with fixed side padding) are this atom's width props in prose.
8px between buttons and the primary ALWAYS first — a group-layout rule for this atom's commonest pattern.
Stacking and full-width differ by platform (app always full width, web keeps dynamic widths) — binds the meta's `responsive` block.
Placement: web left aligned, app bottom, processes back-left/continue-right with the primary stacking on top on small viewports.
Buttons are always rectangular, never rounded — a shape token fixed for this atom.
Label centred both ways, fixed side padding in BOTH width modes, copy should not wrap — the geometry of this atom's label slot.
Icons in buttons: globally recognised only, used sparingly, from a blessed list, in three structural variations (label / icon-label / icon-only) — fixes this atom's icon prop.
The app 'button activity' contract (loading indicator → RAG notification state → resolution, with an accessible label) is the contract behind this meta's `processing` and `sucess (app)` variants.
Button copy: sentence case, ≤5 words, action verbs, precise, 'Continue' not 'Next' — the content contract for this atom's only slot.
Accessible name = the visible label, and target ≥44×44 covering the ENTIRE container — the accessibility contract, and 2.5.3 Label in Name kin (one of the 17 this lane proposes).
